title: gateway: claudeRoom remakes its freed channel the way filememo did before #3632, so a Claude Code run in a synctest bubble would crash the next release outside it
body:
Came up in the review of #3632. `claudeRoomT.release` closes `c.freed` and makes the next one every time a Claude Code process ends, and `nudge` does the same while an ask waits for room. `claudeRoom` is a package-level var, so if a test ever runs a Claude Code turn inside a synctest bubble, the next `freed` belongs to that bubble. The next release outside it (or an ask that waits on it, or a nudge) is then a fatal error, and it takes the whole gateway test binary down in whichever test runs Claude Code next.

Nothing hits it today: gateway's only synctest tests are TestConcurrentClassification*, which call classify with a fake ask. That's how filememo looked before a provider test wrote in a bubble. A take and release in a bubble, then one outside it, shows it on 098ac969:

```
fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble

goroutine 210 [running]:
github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway.(*claudeRoomT).release(...)
	internal/gateway/claude_room.go:294
```

The fix would be the same as for filememo: make `freed` only when an ask has to wait, and have release and nudge close it only if one was taken. trace's `wake` already works that way. I'll put a patch here.
